excluded.reason: E1-E3 do not run on constructed inputs: harness_binsec_verdicts and harness_binsec_population execute courts/phase18/timing/binsec_checkct.sh with bash and call compile_elf, and harness_branch_audit calls require_tool('objdump') and compile_asm; compile_elf and compile_asm call require_tool('cc'). A package containing this tool would depend on a shell, a C compiler and binutils, which are outside the declared Python-only minimum.
the E1/E2 instrument is a shell script that invokes the BINSEC and Z3 stand-ins
the E3 instrument invokes objdump and is measured against compiled shared objects
the E4 timing experiment compiles a C harness; no Rust or C build is in this package
E4 reads a recorded timing receipt; the receipt is evidence about a run this package cannot re-execute
the ETP-6 builder calls git, rustc/cargo and the court container; it cannot run in the declared minimum environment
the court launcher is out of scope for conversion items and needs Docker
no Rust source is needed: the packaged verifier reads JSON records and Python modules only
an evidence record is packaged only when a packaged verifier reads it; a record added without its reader would imply a check that does not run

exclusionRule: A file is packaged only when every input it reads is in the package and every program it executes is the declared Python interpreter. A file that needs the court container, the Rust toolchain, a C compiler, binutils, a shell script, a network service or private state is excluded and named with the reason it cannot run offline.

refusalCodes.EV_REFUSED_ABSOLUTE_PATH: a path is absolute, contains a parent traversal, or is a symlink that resolves outside the tree
refusalCodes.EV_REFUSED_ENTRYPOINT_FAILED: the entry point exits nonzero or raises before writing its records
refusalCodes.EV_REFUSED_EXTERNAL_NOT_RUN: an external run is claimed but no party outside this project has produced a verdict
refusalCodes.EV_REFUSED_MANIFEST_MISMATCH: a member's bytes do not match its recorded size and SHA-256, or a produced record is not byte-identical to the expected record
refusalCodes.EV_REFUSED_MISSING_INPUT: a declared input is absent at build time, or a manifest-declared member is absent at verification time
refusalCodes.EV_REFUSED_NETWORK: a member imports a network client, or the entry point loads one at run time
refusalCodes.EV_REFUSED_PACKAGE_MUTATED: the package directory contains a file the manifest does not name, or the manifest body no longer matches its own digest
refusalCodes.EV_REFUSED_PRIVATE_STATE: a member or the package metadata names court/tmp, a private scratch path or an environment token
refusalCodes.EV_REFUSED_REPRODUCIBLE: two runs of the entry point in fresh directories produce different output or different records
refusalCodes.EV_REFUSED_UNDECLARED_DEPENDENCY: the entry point opens a file outside the package and outside the interpreter's own library, or a build path is outside the declared set
refusalCodes.EV_REFUSED_UNDECLARED_TOOL: a member imports or calls a program (subprocess, ctypes, a shell), or the interpreter is below the declared minimum
refusalCodes.EV_REFUSED_UNTRACKED_INPUT: a declared input is not tracked by Git at the named candidate

strippedEnvironmentCommand: env -i PATH=<directory containing python3> HOME=<fresh dir> TMPDIR=<fresh dir> python3 verify.py
